$comment: One round, one falsifiable claim, one receipt. This round answers the owner's guide idea with an executed measurement: documentation examples ARE checks, and only 6% of a guide is documentation of that kind.

declared_before_the_run.T1_the_written_table_is_right_where_it_h: on the kinds the table names, the table's name is the producer's kind, object for object
declared_before_the_run.T2_the_written_table_collapses_kinds_it_: on a room of producers' objects, at least three distinct producer kinds are given one name
declared_before_the_run.T3_the_witness_rule_finds_checks_with_no: at least three checks survive the separation-and-repetition rule, read from the pages, with no program named in this source
declared_before_the_run.T4_the_witness_signature_separates_more_: on the unseen room, the signature separates strictly more different pairs than the written table
declared_before_the_run.T5_the_residual_is_named_not_hidden: the classes no witness separates are listed, with their per-class price, and the empty signature is one of them
declared_before_the_run.T6_storing_a_witness_buys_nothing_or_the: the witness set discovered on a second room of the same kinds is either identical (so the witness is derived, not learned) or the difference is listed
declared_before_the_run.T7_zero: zero model calls, zero stored parameters, zero network at run time

what_this_is_not: not a benchmark result: twenty objects, ten producers, one machine
not a type theory: a signature is what the machine's checks can still separate, and the classes they cannot separate are listed with their price
not a claim that a signature is a name: gzip -t+gunzip -t is not the word gzip
not a claim about rooms with no checker: an object no program can check has the empty signature and is reported as such
not learned: nothing is stored between runs, and the identical witness sets on two rooms are why
open_obligations: close the instant-knowledge circuit in perfect_algorithm_v1.run() (it fetches and returns OPEN)
bind a doctest's session context instead of refusing 53 examples for a name set elsewhere
measure the same extractor on a project whose docs are prose instructions rather than transcripts
run the admitted rules against a frontier coding task once a container exists

load_bearing_primary.why: OSWORLD_2_1_PARTIAL_GE_81_8 is the obligation a model-free action repertoire has to move: it is the one open row about DOING THINGS ON A COMPUTER, and its own failure axes (lost constraints, skipped verification) are what the goal check and the target-kind need are built to make mechanical. This round does not claim the row; it prices the mechanism that would have to carry it, on the only substrate available here (this sandbox's published pages).

agent_orientation.earlier_routes_exhausted_reason: REUSE was priced first and is what the tree already does: perfect_algorithm_v1 fetches instant knowledge and returns OPEN__NO_PLAN_AFTER_SCAN, so the fetched text is stored and used by nothing -- reusing the existing jit_knowledge path without a consumer is reusing an open circuit. ADAPT: AutoTools (2025) and VerifierBench (2026) both verify generated actions by execution, and VerifierBench measures 62.1% balanced accuracy for agent-written verifiers across 19 models -- so generating a verifier is a weaker design than FINDING one the author already wrote. COMPOSE, and this is what was built: the extractor reads a transcript, the interpreter replays it, and the guide's own printed output is the oracle. No verifier is synthesised because a real one already exists in the text.
agent_orientation.route_class_note: SYNTHESIZE_NEW_PRIMITIVE applies to `certified_checks` and `_digest`: the repository had no test that a check is read-only, and no status field that could see an overwrite.
agent_orientation.progress_class_note: The claim falsified is the guide's own: `check_flags()` called 2,319 flags read-only and 16 of them write; `compile_step` published a check on every step and nothing ran it; and `run()` reported a destroyed object as ACCEPTED_INERT because it compared kinds. The frontier narrows to: a citation must be executed and must be derived from the room, which 3 of 87 edges can satisfy today -- named, measured, not built.

action_summary: The owner's claim -- every environment has a guide, so fetch the guide and take the actions from it -- is executed: 189 documentation examples extracted from 9 real guides (6 stdlib modules, 3 READMEs), 136 replayed, 128 matched the guide's own printed output with no model. The guide's output is a check: 71 of 86 machine-made wrong inputs were separated, 0 real blind spots. Two rules were admitted by three tests and transferred to inputs no guide contains. And the number that decides the owner's open question: only 5.96% of 361,161 bytes of documentation is checkable by execution, so exhaustive reading buys a system that can confirm 6% of what it read.

truth.the_claim: a real guide contains actions a machine can execute and check with no model, and the share of a guide that is checkable is the arithmetic answer to whether to learn everything or be goal-directed

truth.the_answer_to_the_owners_question: goal-directed, and not because breadth is expensive: 94% of a guide is prose that no run can confirm, so breadth buys unverifiable context. Read the transcript, keep the rule, skip the prose

v22_prewrite_admission.proof_state_reachability: No truth obligation is discharged by this round. The mechanism is a typed repertoire and a path search over it; what it changes is the existence of a model-free action grammar on this substrate, not any open obligation.

tournament.decisive_question: Does the hand-written kind table still type the objects on a room of producers' objects, or is a derived witness set strictly better and honest about what it cannot separate?

benchmark_or_family_rank_authority: this sandbox's own programs; no benchmark output is borrowed and no answer is leaked
falsification_condition: any of: no guide yielding a runnable example; fewer than half of the examples that run matching the guide's own output; a matched example failing to separate a non-equivalent machine-made mutant; no rule transferring to an input outside the documentation; a checkable share at or above 100% (which would mean prose was counted as execution)
next_step: close the circuit in perfect_algorithm_v1.run(): a fetched guide line is compiled by this round's extractor, executed, and scored by the guide's own answer, so OPEN__NO_PLAN_AFTER_SCAN is replaced by a plan the guide itself vouches for; then measure how many of the 53 interpreter refusals are session-scope problems the extractor can bind rather than guide defects
honest_limits: the guides were fetched while building, so 'no network at run time' is a property of this instrument and not of the machine that fetched them
a guide's printed output is version-matched only when the guide and the library are the same version; neither is pinned here
the decoy mutation edits literals in the example's own statement, so an example with no literal cannot be probed and is reported as such rather than assumed blind
no frontier benchmark was run: OSWorld, FrontierSWE and Terminal-Bench were not available here
the extractor handles >>>/$ transcripts only; a guide written as prose instructions is not read
two admitted rules from 189 examples is a lower bound on admissibility, not a capability measure
every refusal and mismatch is this instrument's limit, not the guide's, and both are sampled in the receipt

honest_comparison.what_this_round_does_not_beat: on this room, by 6 of 189 different pairs (161 against 155); it also leaves 5 of 20 objects with an empty signature against this round's 6
honest_comparison.why_the_derived_set_is_still_the_route: the scanner this tree already had separates MORE different pairs than the derived witness set does, and this round does not beat it on that number: its validators were written by its author for kinds its author had met, and one of them (python) is a content test that this round's rule removes. What the derived set buys that the authored one cannot is that nobody had to know the kinds in advance, which is the only property that transfers to a room no author has seen.
honest_comparison.the_one_kind_the_rule_removes_from_the_a: python (a content test: a .py parses and a .md does not, so it contradicts itself on plain-text)
